description: Figure 12, titled "Pass@8 accuracy (on the merge sets of AIME 2024 and AMC) under different generation temperatures," is a line plot that illustrates the relationship between pass@8 accuracy and generation temperature. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," is scaled linearly from 0.1 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "Pass@8 Accuracy," is scaled linearly from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The plot contains two lines: one representing the "On-Policy RL" method and the other representing the "LUFFY" method. The "On-Policy RL" line starts at an accuracy of approximately 50 at a temperature of 0.1 and shows a steady increase, reaching a maximum of about 80 at a temperature of 1.0. The "LUFFY" line begins at a lower accuracy of approximately 40 at a temperature of 0.1 and also increases steadily, reaching a maximum of about 75 at a temperature of 1.0.
